summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for ThreadPoolExecutor worker initialization (initializer/initargs pattern) with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills are in reward_engineering domain; peer_candidates are sibling ThreadPoolExecutor configuration skills (context manager, worker count, ProcessPoolExecutor lifecycle) but represent different method_family and stage. Candidate has unique objective, workflow, and constraints focused on per-worker resource setup amortization.
